intent: Convert an existing committed MatterMaterialBatch into the existing canonical Item Graph without introducing a second resource store, replay ledger, persistence owner, or hidden mass truth.

exactly_once_binding.replay_owner: existing Canonical Item Graph server.output ledger

failure_safety: Item Graph preflight precedes Item Graph mutation.
Full inventory rejects with canonical CONTAINER_FULL and does not mutate Item Graph.
If Matter is already COMMITTED and Item Graph rejects, the existing MW4 material receiver batch remains byte-identical and available for retry.
There are no P7-private delivery receipts or balances; crash/retry identity is carried by immutable Matter batch provenance plus the existing Item Graph replay ledger.

integration_scope.live_graphical_app_wiring_reason: P7.3 exit is the conversion boundary itself; two-client/live convergence and graphical equip-aim-dig-material-inventory composition remain explicit P7.5/P7.7 stages.

implementer_validation.p7_2_bubble_fresh_rerun: NOT_CLAIMED: implementer container reached assertions but hung during shutdown; P7.2 runtime subtree itself is unchanged from previously independently VERIFIED main.

Confirm all runtime changes remain inside existing P7 adapter scope and no foundation/canonical owner changed.
Judge whether the explicit 1 kg -> 1 item/ore product conversion is sufficiently explicit and bounded for current V0 generic ore semantics.
Prove mass conservation including residual accounting; no rounding-up or silent mass disappearance.
Verify unsupported materials fail closed and supported material mapping is explicit.
Verify exactly-once is owned only by canonical Item Graph replay ledger, with deterministic operation identity and full batch checksum in fingerprint.
Verify replay conflicts prevent same batch from being redirected to another player or reused with changed physical contents.
Verify inventory-full failure is mutation-free on Item Graph and preserves the committed MW4 batch for retry.
Verify adapter/coordinator are stateless and introduce no P7-private receipt store, resource inventory, persistence owner, or second Item Graph.
Review whether deferring live graphical/two-client wiring to P7.5/P7.7 is consistent with P7.3 stage boundary.
